interpretation_limits: This run was still running and had not completed the 6362620-row dataset.

The run replays from source row 1 while training uses the first 300000 source rows. Live cumulative metrics overlap training data and are unsuitable for a claim of independent generalization or a controlled model BEFORE/AFTER comparison.
runs and evaluation_totals were read at different times. Their 363200 and 363300 counts must not be treated as an atomic inconsistency.
The latest batch ranking values are zero. A zero rank-AP on a batch without fraud does not establish poor full-run quality; the evaluation document alone does not store that batch's fraud count.
Offline grouped-score AP and latest-batch rank-AP on the dashboard are different aggregations and should not be substituted for one another.

limitations: DT selected for highest validation AP, not the highest fixed-threshold F1; RF has higher test Recall and F1 at threshold 0.50.
DT absolute precision is still below 0.5 percent on test and audit, leaving a high false-alert handling burden.
Test and audit have already been examined. A future independent improvement evaluation needs a new untouched temporal window.
Each classifier has one fixed preset; this is not an exhaustive hyperparameter search.
Timing variation between the two LR measurements prevents a supported claim of faster model scoring.
